title: Architect Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🏛️architect plugin's 9 old crates (bundle semio-s-plugin-architect-spine, spine module semio-s-plugin-architect-spine-module 18.5k lines, and 7 constitutional facade crates) into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-architect` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏛️architect/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy tree per the master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE and its 📋️TEMPLATE.md. Decompose 🦴️spine into the artifact's 🦀️component.rs + 🔧️op/🔺️diff/🗣️dsl/🎒️pack/📡️spr components + ⚙️engine topic files per spine's existing top-level mod structure (adjacency, analyze, exchange, kernel, operations, outputs, program, registers, report, search, status_summary, template, trace, validate). Verify with cargo check (native + wasm32-wasip2), clippy -D warnings, cargo test with wire-format diff proof, then delete old crate manifests and hand off to the registrar.
summary:
Merged 🏛️architect's 9 old crates (bundle `semio-s-plugin-architect-spine`, the 18,468-line `🦴️spine` module crate, and 7 constitutional facade crates of 5–17 lines each) into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-architect` at `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏛️architect/📦️packages/🦀️rust/`, with the full taxonomy tree in Shape V2.

SPINE DECOMPOSITION (43 component files). Spine's 14 top-level `mod` blocks split by role rather than by size: document model to the artifact root (`🦀️component.rs` = Program + schema + sample/empty factories with a flat re-export facade preserving spine's old public surface; `🧱️kernel/` = EntityId/EntityHeader/TextField/QuantitySpec/Trace/Diagnostics; `🗄️registers/` = the 65 register row types, 11.4k lines); the op/diff layers to the constitutional slots (`🔧️op/` = ProgramOperation + apply/invert + OpText/OpBinary + `Operation<Program>`; `🔺️diff/` = ProgramDiff + `OperationDiff<Program>`); and the ten genuinely-compute domains to `⚙️engine/<topic>/🦀️component.rs` (adjacency, analyze, exchange, outputs, report, search, status-summary, template, trace, validate) behind an `⚙️engine/🦀️component.rs` hub that owns `register()` and flat-re-exports every topic. `🗣️dsl`/`🎒️pack`/`📡️spr` came from the old facade crates (protocol → spr).

APP DECOMPOSITION. The 2,208-line bundle crate became `🎛️apps/🏛️architect/`: dispatch-only `🦀️component.rs` with `app_commands!` (22 rows, keyed form), `🎚️config/`, `🎨️chrome/` (UI factories), `🗂️catalog/` (register catalog + arg coercion), 9 `🎮️commands/*` groups, 3 `🎭️modes/*`, 5 `🎭️modes/✏️edit/🪟️windows/*`, 3 `📌️panels/*`.

VERIFICATION. cargo check native + wasm32-wasip2 clean; clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; 250 tests pass (baseline floor 193). Wire format proven byte-identical via before/after hex dump of all 22 ArchitectCommand variants (26 rows incl. Option/bool None|Some pairs) plus 5 ProgramOperation rows. Real 9.7MB wasm32-wasip2 component built and jco-transpiled successfully.

FOUND AND FIXED: the systemic TEMPLATE §12.3 broken-`Ok(` corruption — architect's old bundle crate was non-compiling at HEAD with 26 mismatched-delimiter errors in `handle()`'s match arms, so its 11 tests had never been runnable; forward-fixed during the port. Also fixed 69 clippy findings that rode along with the moved code (65 needless_update, 3 map_unwrap_or, module_inception, needless_pass_by_value, redundant_clone) and dropped 2 genuinely-unused deps (vcs, semio-framework-core).

SHAPE V2 RETROFIT applied mid-flight per ticket 26/08/05/SHAPE-V2-TREE-PURITY-BROADCAST: entry file moved into `📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs` with `[lib] path = "📦️lib.rs"`, 43 leaf `#[path]` strings prefixed `../../` while all 11 grouping `#[path = "."]` resets were left unprefixed (per the corrected rule), and 15 sibling variant files folded into their own `<emoji-folder>/🦀️component.rs`. Re-verified green with a real compile: 250/250, zero drift. Tree purity confirmed — the only non-`🦀️component.rs` files below the plugin root are AGENTS.md and 📚️examples/, both already correctly at the root; no AGENTS.md/README.md collision.

CROSS-PLUGIN DEPENDENTS: none (verified via both Cargo.toml and `use`-line greps; fixture-sweep and dsl/registry both clean). One stale cross-cutting fixture fixed in the repo product's `🧪️index.test.ts`. Old crates deleted; registrar handoff written (9 member lines out, 1 in, no `[workspace.dependencies]` change).
